name: Netmend Resume
title: AI resume tailor and ATS keyword checker: CV + job ad into a tailored CV and cover letter
desc: Paste your CV and a job ad. See your ATS keyword match instantly, then get a tailored, ATS-friendly CV and a cover letter as a PDF. Runs in your browser with your own Gemini key. Free; Pro is $19 lifetime.

intro: Paste your CV and the job ad. Netmend Resume shows which keywords the applicant tracking system will look for and which ones you are missing, then rewrites your CV for that job, without inventing experience, and writes the cover letter.
